name: AG-UI
description: Connects agent backends such as LangChain, CrewAI and Mastra to user-facing apps through an open event protocol and SDKs for streaming chat, shared state and human-in-the-loop UIs, for app developers.

skills.name: Event Streaming
skills.description: Streams typed events for text, tool calls, reasoning, state and lifecycle from any agent backend to your app over SSE or WebSockets.

skills.name: Shared State
skills.description: Synchronizes a typed state store between agent and app with streamed, event-sourced diffs for collaborative interfaces.

skills.name: Frontend Tool Calls
skills.description: Hands tool calls from the agent to actions that run in the frontend, then returns their results back to the agent.

skills.name: Interrupts
skills.description: Pauses an agent run so a user can approve, edit, retry or escalate mid-flow, then resumes the run without losing state.

skills.name: Scaffold an App
skills.description: Scaffolds a new app wired to the agent framework you pick, with a CopilotKit Next.js frontend or a terminal client.
